Flow.description: F-26: Screen Flow to create a new BAN. Launched from Quick Action on Account record. Generates BAN_Number__c based on Account country.

formulas.name: frmSIDescription
formulas.expression: "BAN " & {!var_createdBAN.BAN_Number__c} & " created with Different Invoice Currency. Local currency: " & {!frmDefaultLocalCurrency}

Flow.label: BillingAccount - Screen - Create BAN

fields.name: Copy_1_of_disp_DeliveryError
fields.fieldText:
Invalid Invoice Presentment


The invoice presentment needs to be Edge Default, given the DE Billing Country is Indonesia!


Please go back and select Edge defualt as the Invoice Presentment .

fields.name: disp_SBIWarning
fields.fieldText: This will create a Special Billing Instruction for Finance review. The BAN will invoice in {!frmCurrencyResolved} instead of the BAN currency ({!frmBanCurrencyFinal}).

fields.name: inp_AdditionalEmail
fields.helpText: Optional. Up to two email addresses to CC on invoice delivery. Enter one address per line.

validationRule.errorMessage: Enter up to two valid email addresses, each on its own line (or separated by a comma).

fields.name: disp_DeliveryError
fields.fieldText:
Invalid Invoice Delivery Mode


Indonesia PT billing entities require e-billing. Invoice Delivery Mode must be Online.


Please go back and select Online as the delivery mode.

fields.name: disp_Success
fields.fieldText:
BAN created successfully.

BAN Number: {!var_createdBAN.BAN_Number__c}

The BAN has been automatically submitted for approval.
